# Scientific figure fixtures

`scientific-egfr-mapk.json` records the explicitly supplied reduced human pathway, references and abstraction boundaries used by the real-model scientific case. It does not assert a complete pathway or autonomously verified science.

`scientific-egfr-mapk-illustrated.json` stores only the editable document from the successful 2026-11-10 materialization case, with its scientific references and asset provenance. It contains no gateway session or model credentials. The generic receptor SVG is by **Jan-Jezierski**, licensed **CC0 1.0**:

- [Original SVG](https://bioicons.com/icons/cc-0/Cell_membrane/Jan-Jezierski/receptor.svg)
- [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)

The normalized SVG bytes, original/normalized hashes, author and license are retained in the document. The art is a generic symbol, not a validated EGFR molecular structure. This saved snapshot permits offline geometry/rendering regressions without querying a model or the live asset catalog. It does not provide evidence of a new autonomous Agent run.
